evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:12 — `page.shallow?.url` read; shallow-routing API stable only since SvelteKit 3.0.0 (2026-10-01), used in the app's central filter UI
app/src/routes/+page.svelte:38 — `goto(..., { shallow: true, replace: true })`, the new-for-Kit-3 goto options
app/src/env.js:1 — `defineEnvVars` from `@sveltejs/kit/env`, experimental in 2.62, standard since Kit 3

app/vite.config.js:1-12 — Kit 3 required config style, no experimental flags
reach.rationale: No experimental or preview APIs at all; everything used is stable in SvelteKit 3.1, but two APIs (shallow routing, explicit env vars) are recently-stable (weeks to ~1 month) and one of them sits in the home page's core filtering flow, which lands at 3 rather than 1-2.

evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:12,38 — the only shallow-routing usage in the entire app, one route, with explanatory comments
app/src/env.js:1-10 — env-var definition isolated in the single `src/env.js` file Kit expects
app/src/lib/server/api.js:3 — the only import of `$app/env/private`, behind the server API module
app/src/lib/components/MovesTable.svelte:2-5 — remaining code uses only long-stable Svelte 5 runes
containment.rationale: Both recently-stable APIs are wrapped in exactly one module or one route each, with comments explaining the mechanism; nothing leaks into components or other pages.

evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:34-41 — shallow goto gives URL-synced, debounced filtering over 1,025 species without rerunning the load function; a full navigation per keystroke would be wasteful
app/src/env.js:6-8 — `static: false` is what makes API_BASE_URL read at runtime, which the spec's live-data test (build once, run against a different API) effectively requires
app/src/lib/server/api.js:3 — no legacy `$env/dynamic/private` left behind, avoiding a module Kit 3 already deprecates
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:17 — game selector uses a plain full goto, correctly not reaching for shallow routing where it isn't needed
justification.rationale: Each recently-stable API buys something a stable alternative couldn't: shallow routing is the only way to update URL state reactively without a server round-trip, and runtime (non-inlined) env vars are dictated by the spec's run-time API configuration; neither use is novelty-driven.

findings.issue: `page.shallow?.url ?? page.url` depends on an API surface (goto shallow routing / page.shallow) that only became stable in SvelteKit 3.0.0 on 2026-10-01, so its exact semantics could still shift in 3.x point releases.
findings.suggestion: Fine as-is; if the SvelteKit 3.x behavior of `page.shallow` evolves, keep the `?? page.url` fallback and re-verify this one route after upgrades.

summary: The app contains zero experimental, preview or canary APIs and instead uses SvelteKit 3's new stable conventions (vite.config.js plugin config, `#lib` imports, explicit env vars, goto-based shallow routing) in exactly the places the docs recommend them. The only recency is that shallow routing and defineEnvVars were stabilized within the last ~1-2 months, so reach is moderate rather than minimal. Both uses are isolated to a single module or route and are well justified by the spec's requirements.
